test_cases.title: Start of Mission'da iletişim oturumunun başlatılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU Level 2 modunda yapılandırılmıştır. RBC iletişim bilgileri depolanmıştır.

steps.action: Start of Mission (SoM) prosedürü başlatılır.
steps.expected: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu için istek gönderir.

steps.action: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulduktan sonra 'Initiation of communication session' mesajı gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC'den sistem sürümünü alır ve oturumun kurulduğunu kabul eder.

test_cases.title: Radyo bağlantısı kaybında oturumun yeniden başlatılması
test_cases.preconditions: Aktif bir iletişim oturumu mevcuttur.

steps.action: EURORADIO, güvenli radyo bağlantısının kaybedildiğini bildirir.
steps.expected: OBU, daha önce başarılı olan radyo sistemini kullanarak yeni bir güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurmaya derhal çalışır.

steps.action: Yeni bağlantı kurulur.
steps.expected: OBU, 'Initiation of communication session' mesajını gönderir ve oturumu yeniden başlatır.

test_cases.title: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumunda tekrar denemeleri (SoM dışı)
test_cases.preconditions: SoM prosedürü devam etmemektedir. Mod değişikliği raporu talebi yoktur.

steps.action: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu için istek gönderilir ve ilk deneme başarısız olur.
steps.expected: OBU, EURORADIO'nun başarısızlık bildirmesinin hemen ardından isteği tekrarlar.

steps.action: İkinci deneme de başarısız olur.
steps.expected: OBU, isteği tekrarlar (sınırlı deneme sayısı uygulanmaz, başarılı olana kadar devam eder).

steps.action: Üçüncü deneme başarılı olur.
steps.expected: OBU, 'Initiation of communication session' mesajını gönderir.

test_cases.title: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumunda tekrar denemeleri (SoM sırasında)
test_cases.preconditions: Start of Mission prosedürü devam etmektedir.
test_cases.assumptions: Ek A.3.1'e göre maksimum deneme sayısı 3'tür.

steps.action: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu için istek gönderilir ve ilk deneme başarısız olur.
steps.expected: OBU, isteği tekrarlar.

steps.action: İkinci deneme başarısız olur.
steps.expected: OBU, isteği tekrarlar.

steps.action: Üçüncü deneme başarısız olur.
steps.expected: OBU, denemeyi durdurur (maksimum 3 deneme sınırına ulaşıldı).

test_cases.title: Uyumsuz sistem sürümü durumunda oturumun sonlandırılması
test_cases.preconditions: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulmuştur.

steps.action: OBU, 'Initiation of communication session' mesajını gönderir.
steps.expected: RBC, OBU ile uyumlu olmayan bir sistem sürümü bildirir.

steps.action: OBU, uyumsuz sürüm bilgisini işler.
steps.expected: OBU, 'No compatible version supported' mesajını gönderir, sürücüye bilgi verir ve oturumu sonlandırır.

test_cases.title: Çift radyo sistemi varlığında öncelik sırasına göre seçim (Trackside emri)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hem FRMCS hem GSM-R mevcuttur. Depolanan Radio Network tipi FRMCS+GSM-R'dir.

steps.action: Trackside'dan, sadece FRMCS ile arayüze sahip bir RBC ile oturum kurma emri alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, FRMCS radyo sistemini kullanarak güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu için istek gönderir.

test_cases.title: Çift radyo sistemi varlığında öncelik sırasına göre seçim (Sürücü tercihi)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hem FRMCS hem GSM-R mevcuttur. SoM sırasında sürücü tek radyo sistemi (GSM-R) ile görev yapmayı seçmiştir.

steps.action: Trackside emri yoksa ve SoM sırasında sürücü GSM-R seçtiyse, oturum kurulumu tetiklenir.
steps.expected: OBU, GSM-R radyo sistemini kullanarak güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu için istek gönderir.

test_cases.title: Çift radyo sistemi varlığında öncelik sırasına göre seçim (Depolanan bilgi)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hem FRMCS hem GSM-R mevcuttur. Trackside emri yoktur. Sürücü tek radyo tercihi yapmamıştır. Depolanan Radio Network tipi FRMCS+GSM-R'dir ve önceki oturumda FRMCS kullanılmıştır.

steps.action: Oturum kurulumu tetiklenir.
steps.expected: OBU, depolanan tercihli radyo sistemini (FRMCS) kullanarak güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu için istek gönderir.

test_cases.title: Başarılı radyo sisteminin hafızaya alınması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hem FRMCS hem GSM-R mevcuttur.

steps.action: GSM-R üzerinden güvenli radyo bağlantısı başarıyla kurulur.
steps.expected: OBU, başarılı kurulumun GSM-R üzerinden yapıldığını hafızaya alır.

steps.action: Oturum sonlandırılır ve yeni bir oturum kurulumu tetiklenir (öncelik sırasına göre depolanan bilgiye başvurulacaksa).
steps.expected: OBU, depolanan radyo sistemi bilgisinin GSM-R olduğunu doğrular.

test_cases.title: Oturum kurulumu sırasında End of Mission ile iptal
test_cases.preconditions: Oturum kurulumu süreci devam etmektedir (güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulmuş, sistem sürümü bekleniyor).

steps.action: End of Mission prosedürü başlatılır.
steps.expected: OBU, oturum kurulumunu iptal eder ve mevcut güvenli radyo bağlantısını serbest bırakır.

test_cases.title: Oturum kurulumu sırasında Level 2 sınırını geçiş ile iptal
test_cases.preconditions: Oturum kurulumu süreci devam etmektedir. Tren Level 2 alanında hareket etmektedir.

steps.action: Trenin minimum güvenli arka ucu, Level 2 desteklenmeyen bir alana geçiş sınırını (Level 2 exit) geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, oturum kurulumunu iptal eder ve güvenli radyo bağlantısını serbest bırakır.

test_cases.title: Son bilinen RBC emrinde telefon numarasının yok sayılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da RBC iletişim bilgileri depolanmıştır. Trackside'dan 'son bilinen RBC' emri alınır.

steps.action: Trackside'dan, özel RBC kimlik değeri (son bilinen RBC) ve bir telefon numarası içeren oturum kurma emri alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, emirdeki telefon numarasını yok sayar ve depolanan RBC iletişim bilgilerini kullanarak RBC'ye bağlanır.

test_cases.title: Depolanan RBC bilgisi yokken son bilinen RBC emrinin yok sayılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da RBC iletişim bilgileri depolanmamıştır.

steps.action: Trackside'dan, özel RBC kimlik değeri (son bilinen RBC) içeren oturum kurma emri alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, bu emri yok sayar ve iletişim oturumu başlatmaz.

test_cases.title: OBU does not open a second session with the same RBC while the first is being established
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A Start of Mission procedure is initiated, triggering a communication session establishment with RBC-A. The session establishment process is in progress (not yet complete).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is configured to allow manual level changes or other triggers that could potentially initiate a new session request while the first is pending.

steps.action: Initiate Start of Mission in Level 2 to start establishing a session with RBC-A.
steps.expected: OBU begins the process to establish a communication session with RBC-A.

steps.action: While the session with RBC-A is still being established, trigger another condition that would normally require a session with RBC-A (e.g., manual selection of RBC-A contact info or a mode change report).
steps.expected: OBU does not initiate a new communication session establishment process with RBC-A. The original establishment process continues.

test_cases.title: OBU does not open a second session with the same RBC while an active session exists without termination
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 and has an established communication session with RBC-A. No Termination of Communication Session message has been sent to RBC-A.

steps.action: Verify that a communication session with RBC-A is active and no termination message has been sent.
steps.expected: OBU status indicates an active session with RBC-A.

steps.action: Trigger a condition that would normally require a new session with RBC-A (e.g., an order from trackside to establish a session with RBC-A).
steps.expected: OBU does not attempt to establish a new communication session with RBC-A. The existing session remains active.

test_cases.title: OBU terminates existing session with other RBCs when establishing a new session
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 and has an established communication session with RBC-A. OBU is capable of handling multiple sessions or is in a state where it needs to switch to RBC-B.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is not in the specific exception case of an Accepting RBC embedded in an RBC transition order where the current session should be kept.

steps.action: Trigger the establishment of a new communication session with RBC-B (e.g., via an RBC transition order or manual selection).
steps.expected: OBU initiates the termination of the existing session with RBC-A by sending a Termination of Communication Session message to RBC-A.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's behavior after sending the termination message.
steps.expected: OBU proceeds to establish the new communication session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: OBU evaluates balise information validity based on crossing direction in Shunting mode
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Shunting (SH) mode. The train is moving in the reverse direction relative to the nominal track direction. A balise group is encountered that contains information valid for the reverse direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise data containing speed restrictions valid for the reverse direction.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is correctly configured for Shunting mode and the balise data is correctly formatted.

steps.action: Move the train in the reverse direction over a balise group containing information valid for the reverse direction.
steps.expected: OBU takes into account the speed restriction information from the balise group.

steps.action: Move the train in the reverse direction over a balise group containing information valid only for the nominal (forward) direction.
steps.expected: OBU ignores the speed restriction information from the balise group.

test_cases.title: OBU keeps applying last received MA request parameters until new ones are received
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 and has received MA request parameters from RBC-A (e.g., repetition period T_CYCRQST = 10s).
test_cases.test_inputs: MA request parameters with T_CYCRQST = 10s.

steps.action: Receive MA request parameters from RBC-A with a repetition period of 10 seconds.
steps.expected: OBU stores the parameters and begins repeating MA requests every 10 seconds if applicable.

steps.action: Wait for 5 seconds and verify that no new parameters have been received.
steps.expected: OBU continues to use the previously received parameters (10s repetition period).

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from RBC-A with a repetition period of 20 seconds.
steps.expected: OBU immediately replaces the old parameters with the new ones (20s repetition period).

test_cases.title: OBU sends MA request immediately if time since last request exceeds new repetition period
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. The last MA request was sent 15 seconds ago. The current MA request parameters have a repetition period of 10 seconds.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters with T_CYCRQST = 10s.

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from RBC-A with a repetition period of 10 seconds.
steps.expected: OBU checks the time since the last MA request (15s) against the new repetition period (10s).

steps.action: Observe the OBU's behavior immediately after receiving the new parameters.
steps.expected: OBU sends an MA request immediately because 15s >= 10s.

test_cases.title: OBU does not define Supervised Location while supervising a Limit of Authority
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 and is supervising a Limit of Authority (LOA) with a target speed above zero.

steps.action: Verify that the OBU is supervising a Limit of Authority.
steps.expected: OBU status indicates that a LOA is being supervised.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state for any defined Supervised Location (SvL).
steps.expected: No Supervised Location (SvL) is defined on board. None of the candidates (end of overlap, Danger Point, end of End Section) are used as SvL.

test_cases.title: OBU keeps Level 1 signalling related speed restriction valid until a new one is received
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 and has received a signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h.
test_cases.test_inputs: Signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h.

steps.action: Receive a signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h in Level 1.
steps.expected: OBU applies the 80 km/h speed restriction.

steps.action: Wait for a period without receiving any new signalling related speed restriction.
steps.expected: OBU continues to apply the 80 km/h speed restriction.

steps.action: Receive a new signalling related speed restriction of 60 km/h.
steps.expected: OBU replaces the 80 km/h restriction with the 60 km/h restriction.

test_cases.title: OBU keeps Level 1 signalling related speed restriction valid after switching to Level 2 until MA is accepted
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 and has a signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h. OBU switches to Level 2.

steps.action: Switch the OBU from Level 1 to Level 2 while the 80 km/h signalling related speed restriction is active.
steps.expected: OBU continues to apply the 80 km/h speed restriction in Level 2.

steps.action: Accept a Level 2 Movement Authority (MA) that does not include a conflicting speed restriction.
steps.expected: OBU stops applying the Level 1 signalling related speed restriction and follows the Level 2 MA.

test_cases.title: OBU allows definition of maximum train speed and handles it as a Static Speed Restriction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where Train Data can be configured.
test_cases.test_inputs: Maximum train speed value of 200 km/h.

steps.action: Define the maximum train speed as 200 km/h in the Train Data.
steps.expected: OBU accepts the value and stores it as the Maximum Train Speed.

steps.action: Verify that the OBU includes the 200 km/h value in the calculation of the Most Restrictive Speed Profile (MRSP).
steps.expected: The 200 km/h value is considered as a Static Speed Restriction category in the MRSP calculation.

test_cases.title: OBU considers no permitted braking distance speed restriction in initial state
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in its initial state, before any speed restriction to ensure permitted braking distance has been computed.

steps.action: Verify the OBU's state regarding speed restrictions to ensure permitted braking distance.
steps.expected: OBU considers that no such speed restriction applies.

steps.action: Check the OBU's speed monitoring logic.
steps.expected: No permitted-braking-distance limit constrains the train speed.

test_cases.title: Immediate reconnection attempt on safe radio loss
test_cases.preconditions: A safe radio connection is established via a specific radio system (e.g., GSM-R). The communication session is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection signal from EURORADIO.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is in a state where it can initiate a new connection setup. The 'immediately' timeframe is defined by the system's reaction time specifications.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection via EURORADIO.
steps.expected: The OBU detects the loss of the safe radio connection.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's behavior immediately after the loss detection.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates an attempt to set up a new safe radio connection using the same radio system that was previously used.

test_cases.title: Repeated reconnection attempts until success
test_cases.preconditions: The safe radio connection is lost. The OBU is in the process of attempting to re-establish the connection.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated failure of the first reconnection attempt, followed by a successful reconnection attempt.
test_cases.assumptions: The session is not terminated and the train has not passed the RIU termination location.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts the reconnection process.

steps.action: Simulate a failure of the first reconnection attempt.
steps.expected: The OBU does not stop; it initiates a second attempt to set up the safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate a successful reconnection attempt on the second try.
steps.expected: The safe radio connection is established, and the OBU stops the reconnection attempts.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when session is terminated
test_cases.preconditions: The safe radio connection is lost. The OBU is repeating reconnection attempts.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated session termination signal (e.g., timeout or explicit termination command).
test_cases.assumptions: The session termination condition is met before a new connection is established.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts repeating reconnection attempts.

steps.action: Simulate the condition where the session is regarded as terminated (e.g., defined time expires without reconnection).
steps.expected: The OBU stops the reconnection attempts.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when train passes RIU termination location
test_cases.preconditions: The safe radio connection is lost. The OBU is repeating reconnection attempts. An RIU order to terminate the communication session is active with a specific location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train position data indicating passage of the RIU termination location.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving towards and past the location specified in the RIU order.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts repeating reconnection attempts.

steps.action: Simulate the train passing the location indicated in the RIU order 'Terminate the communication session'.
steps.expected: The OBU stops the reconnection attempts.

test_cases.title: Termination initiated by trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established between the OBU and the RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside termination order message.

steps.action: Send a termination order from the trackside (RBC) to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination of the communication session.

test_cases.title: Termination initiated by internal condition
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger an internal termination condition (e.g., loss of radio link or specific state change defined in SUBSET-026).
test_cases.assumptions: The specific internal condition is testable and does not require an explicit trackside order.

steps.action: Trigger the internal termination condition on the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination of the communication session without receiving a trackside order.

test_cases.title: No termination without valid trigger
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established.
test_cases.test_inputs: None (no trackside order, no internal condition triggered).

steps.action: Wait for a duration longer than the fixed waiting time without sending any trackside order or triggering any internal termination condition.
steps.expected: The OBU does not initiate the termination of the communication session.

test_cases.title: Repetition of Termination message upon no acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has sent the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.
test_cases.test_inputs: No acknowledgement from trackside.
test_cases.assumptions: Fixed waiting time is 15 seconds as per Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time (15 seconds) after the first 'Termination of Communication Session' message without receiving an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU sends the 'Termination of Communication Session' message again.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time (15 seconds) after the second 'Termination of Communication Session' message without receiving an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU sends the 'Termination of Communication Session' message again.

test_cases.title: Session considered terminated after max repetitions
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in the process of terminating a session and has already repeated the 'Termination of Communication Session' message the defined number of times (3 times, excluding the first send, so 4 total sends).
test_cases.test_inputs: No acknowledgement from trackside.
test_cases.assumptions: Defined number of repetitions is 3 times as per Appendix A.3.1. Fixed waiting time is 15 seconds.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time (15 seconds) after the last (4th) 'Termination of Communication Session' message without receiving an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the communication session terminated.

test_cases.title: GSM-R registration at power-up
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered off. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected and powered on. The GSM-R Radio Network is available.

steps.action: Power on the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the registration process for the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the GSM-R Radio Network.

steps.action: Wait for the registration process to complete.
steps.expected: The GSM-R Mobile Terminal status indicates it is registered to the GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: GSM-R registration after driver enters new network identity
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected and registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: New GSM-R Radio Network identity (e.g., different PLMN ID).

steps.action: Driver enters a new GSM-R Radio Network identity into the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the registration process for the GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the new GSM-R Radio Network.

steps.action: Wait for the registration process to complete.
steps.expected: The GSM-R Mobile Terminal status indicates it is registered to the new GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: GSM-R registration when ordered by trackside
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected but not registered to a GSM-R Radio Network (or registered to a different one).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to register GSM-R Mobile Terminal.
test_cases.assumptions: Trackside can send a specific order for GSM-R registration.

steps.action: Send a trackside order to the OBU to register the GSM-R Mobile Terminal.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the registration process for the GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the GSM-R Radio Network.

steps.action: Wait for the registration process to complete.
steps.expected: The GSM-R Mobile Terminal status indicates it is registered to the GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: Use of default Radio Network type after System Failure
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. A System Failure occurs, clearing the memorised Radio Network type. The default Radio Network type is configured on-board (e.g., GSM-R).
test_cases.assumptions: The default Radio Network type is configured to GSM-R for this test.

steps.action: Trigger a System Failure to clear the memorised Radio Network type.
steps.expected: The OBU detects the absence of a memorised Radio Network type.

steps.action: Check the Radio Network type used by the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the default Radio Network type configured on-board (GSM-R).

test_cases.title: Use of default Radio Network type at first power-up
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered off. No Radio Network type has ever been memorised (first power-up). The default Radio Network type is configured on-board (e.g., GSM-R).
test_cases.assumptions: The default Radio Network type is configured to GSM-R for this test.

steps.action: Power on the OBU for the first time.
steps.expected: The OBU detects the absence of a memorised Radio Network type.

steps.action: Check the Radio Network type used by the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the default Radio Network type configured on-board (GSM-R).

test_cases.title: No RBC session request when FRMCS only installed and not registered
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Stored Radio Network type is FRMCS. Only FRMCS is installed on-board. FRMCS is not registered to the FRMCS Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to establish a session with an RBC.

steps.action: Send a trackside order to the OBU to establish a session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No RBC session request when FRMCS+GSM-R installed, FRMCS not registered, no single-radio choice
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed on-board. Driver has not elected to perform the mission with only one radio system. FRMCS is not registered to the FRMCS Radio Network. GSM-R is registered to the GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to establish a session with an RBC.

steps.action: Send a trackside order to the OBU to establish a session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No RBC session request when FRMCS+GSM-R installed, GSM-R not registered, no single-radio choice
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed on-board. Driver has not elected to perform the mission with only one radio system. FRMCS is registered to the FRMCS Radio Network. GSM-R is not registered to the GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to establish a session with an RBC.

steps.action: Send a trackside order to the OBU to establish a session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No RBC session request when single-radio choice FRMCS and FRMCS not registered
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed on-board. Driver has elected to perform the mission with only FRMCS. FRMCS is not registered to the FRMCS Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to establish a session with an RBC.

steps.action: Send a trackside order to the OBU to establish a session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No RBC session request when single-radio choice GSM-R and GSM-R not registered
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed on-board. Driver has elected to perform the mission with only GSM-R. GSM-R is not registered to the GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to establish a session with an RBC.

steps.action: Send a trackside order to the OBU to establish a session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No RBC session request when GSM-R only installed and not registered
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Stored Radio Network type is GSM-R. Only GSM-R is installed on-board. GSM-R is not registered to the GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to establish a session with an RBC.

steps.action: Send a trackside order to the OBU to establish a session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No RIU session request when GSM-R not registered
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected but not registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to establish a communication session with an RIU.

steps.action: Send a trackside order to the OBU to establish a communication session with an RIU.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulduğunda ST03 sembolünün gösterilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, ilgili RBC/RIU ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurma sürecinde 'Connection Up' durumuna geçmiştir.
test_cases.assumptions: E1 ekranı sürücü tarafından gözlemlenebilir durumda ve ST03 sembolü tanımlıdır.

steps.action: OBU'nun güvenli radyo bağlantısı durumunun 'Connection Up' olduğu doğrulanır.
steps.expected: E1 ekranında ST03 sembolü görünür.

test_cases.title: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı yokken sembolün gösterilmemesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, ilgili RBC/RIU ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurma sürecinde 'No Connection' durumundadır.
test_cases.assumptions: E1 ekranı sürücü tarafından gözlemlenebilir durumda ve ST03/ST04 sembolleri tanımlıdır.

steps.action: OBU'nun güvenli radyo bağlantısı durumunun 'No Connection' olduğu doğrulanır.
steps.expected: E1 ekranında ST03 veya ST04 sembolü görünmez.

test_cases.title: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kaybolduğunda/kurulamadığında ST04 sembolünün gösterilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, ilgili RBC/RIU ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurma sürecinde 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' durumuna geçmiştir.
test_cases.assumptions: E1 ekranı sürücü tarafından gözlemlenebilir durumda ve ST04 sembolü tanımlıdır.

steps.action: OBU'nun güvenli radyo bağlantısı durumunun 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' olduğu doğrulanır.
steps.expected: E1 ekranında ST04 sembolü görünür.

test_cases.title: İlk kurulum isteği gönderildiğinde bağlantı durum zamanlayıcısının başlatılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, 'No Connection' durumundadır ve henüz güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurma isteği göndermemiştir.
test_cases.assumptions: Bağlantı durum zamanlayıcısının (connection status timer) durumu izlenebilir veya loglanabilir.

steps.action: OBU'nun ilgili RBC/RIU ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurmak için ilk isteği gönderdiği gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Bağlantı durum zamanlayıcısının başlatıldığı doğrulanır.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı durum zamanlayıcısının süresi dolunca durum değişikliği
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, 'No Connection' durumundadır ve bağlantı durum zamanlayıcısı başlatılmıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: Bağlantı durum zamanlayıcısının süresi dolması simüle edilebilir veya beklenilebilir.

steps.action: Bağlantı durum zamanlayıcısının süresi dolana kadar beklenir.
steps.expected: OBU'nun durumu 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' olarak değişir (Tablo 2, Koşul 2).

steps.action: E1 ekranı gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: E1 ekranında ST04 sembolü görünür.

test_cases.title: Güvenli radyo bağlantısının kurulmasıyla durumun 'Connection Up' olması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, 'No Connection' veya 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' durumundadır.
test_cases.assumptions: Güvenli radyo bağlantısının kurulması simüle edilebilir.

steps.action: Güvenli radyo bağlantısının kurulduğu simüle edilir (Tablo 2, Koşul 4).
steps.expected: OBU'nun durumu 'Connection Up' olarak değişir.

steps.action: E1 ekranı gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: E1 ekranında ST03 sembolü görünür.

test_cases.title: Güvenli radyo bağlantısının kaybolmasıyla durumun 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' olması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, 'Connection Up' durumundadır.
test_cases.assumptions: Güvenli radyo bağlantısının kaybolması simüle edilebilir.

steps.action: Güvenli radyo bağlantısının kaybolduğu ve kurulum isteklerinin durdurulduğu simüle edilir (Tablo 2, Koşul 6).
steps.expected: OBU'nun durumu 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' olarak değişir.

steps.action: E1 ekranı gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: E1 ekranında ST04 sembolü görünür.

test_cases.title: RIU ile bağlantıda mevcut dolgu alanına ait durumun gösterilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, birden fazla RIU ile güvenli radyo bağlantısına sahiptir ve tren mevcut dolgu alanı (infill area) içinde hareket etmektedir.
test_cases.assumptions: Mevcut dolgu alanı ve ilgili RIU'nun bağlantı durumu izlenebilir.

steps.action: Mevcut dolgu alanına ait RIU'nun bağlantı durumu 'Connection Up' olarak ayarlanır.
steps.expected: Sürücüye gösterilen durum 'Connection Up' olur ve E1'de ST03 sembolü görünür.

steps.action: Mevcut dolgu alanına ait RIU'nun bağlantı durumu 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' olarak ayarlanır.
steps.expected: Sürücüye gösterilen durum 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' olur ve E1'de ST04 sembolü görünür.

test_cases.title: LRBG geçişinde geçersiz konumun silinmesi ve geçerli konumun kabulü
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, tren konumunun bilinmediği veya geçersiz olduğu bir durumda başlatılır. Geçersiz bir tren konumu bellekte saklanmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: LRBG uyumlu balise grubu geçiş sinyali.
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG balise grubunun LRBG uyumlu olduğu ve konum raporlaması için kullanılabilir olduğu varsayılır.

steps.action: Trenin LRBG uyumlu bir balise grubunu geçtiği simüle edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, geçerli bir tren konumunun araç üstü birimde saklandığını kabul eder.

steps.action: Önceden saklanan geçersiz tren konumu verisi kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Geçersiz tren konumu verisi silinmiştir.

test_cases.title: ORBG geçişinde geçersiz konumun silinmesi ve geçerli konumun kabulü
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, tren konumunun bilinmediği veya geçersiz olduğu bir durumda başlatılır. Geçersiz bir tren konumu bellekte saklanmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: ORBG balise grubu geçiş sinyali.
test_cases.assumptions: ORBG balise grubunun geçerli bir referans noktası olarak tanımlandığı varsayılır.

steps.action: Trenin ORBG olarak işaretlenmiş bir balise grubunu geçtiği simüle edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, geçerli bir tren konumunun araç üstü birimde saklandığını kabul eder.

steps.action: Önceden saklanan geçersiz tren konumu verisi kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Geçersiz tren konumu verisi silinmiştir.

test_cases.title: Aktif kabin varken tren yönünün aktif kabin tarafına göre belirlenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Trenin iki kabini vardır. Kabin A aktif, Kabin B pasiftir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Kabin A aktif durumu sinyali.
test_cases.assumptions: Kabin A'nın trenin ön tarafını temsil ettiği varsayılır.

steps.action: Kabin A'nın aktif olduğu durum OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, trenin yönünü Kabin A'nın tarafına göre belirler.

steps.action: Tren konumu verisindeki yön parametresi kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Yön parametresi, Kabin A'nın tarafını gösterir.

test_cases.title: Aktif kabin yokken tren yönünün son aktif kabin tarafına göre belirlenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Trenin iki kabini vardır. Kabin A son olarak aktif olan kabindi, ancak şu anda hiçbir kabin aktif değildir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tüm kabinlerin pasif olduğu durum sinyali.
test_cases.assumptions: Kabin A'nın son aktif kabin olduğu varsayılır.

steps.action: Hiçbir kabinin aktif olmadığı durum OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, trenin yönünü son aktif kabin olan Kabin A'nın tarafına göre belirler.

steps.action: Tren konumu verisindeki yön parametresi kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Yön parametresi, Kabin A'nın tarafını gösterir.

test_cases.title: Konum tabanlı denetimde tahmini ön ucun kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: Tren konumu geçerlidir. Konum tabanlı bir denetim fonksiyonu (örneğin hız denetimi) aktiftir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tahmini ön ucun konumu: 1000 m, Min güvenli ön ucun konumu: 990 m, Max güvenli ön ucun konumu: 1010 m.
test_cases.assumptions: Denetlenen fonksiyon için SUBSET-026'da başka bir referans noktası belirtilmemiştir.

steps.action: Konum tabanlı denetim fonksiyonu tetiklenir.
steps.expected: OBU, denetim hesabında tahmini ön ucun konumunu (1000 m) referans olarak kullanır.

steps.action: Denetim sonucundaki referans noktası kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Referans noktası 1000 m olarak kaydedilmiştir.

test_cases.title: End Section zamanlayıcısı için max güvenli ön ucun kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: Tren konumu geçerlidir. End Section zamanlayıcısı başlangıç konumu denetimi aktiftir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tahmini ön ucun konumu: 1000 m, Max güvenli ön ucun konumu: 1010 m.
test_cases.assumptions: End Section zamanlayıcısı başlangıç konumu için SUBSET-026 max güvenli ön ucunu referans olarak belirtir.

steps.action: End Section zamanlayıcısı başlangıç konumu denetimi tetiklenir.
steps.expected: OBU, denetim hesabında max güvenli ön ucun konumunu (1010 m) referans olarak kullanır.

steps.action: Denetim sonucundaki referans noktası kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Referans noktası 1010 m olarak kaydedilmiştir.

test_cases.title: Seviye geçiş sınırı için min güvenli arka ucun kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: Tren konumu geçerlidir. Seviye geçiş sınırı denetimi aktiftir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tahmini ön ucun konumu: 1000 m, Min güvenli ön ucun konumu: 990 m, Tren uzunluğu: 200 m.
test_cases.assumptions: Min güvenli arka ucun konumu, min güvenli ön ucun konumundan tren uzunluğu çıkarılarak hesaplanır (990 - 200 = 790 m). Seviye geçiş sınırı için SUBSET-026 min güvenli arka ucunu referans olarak belirtir.

steps.action: Seviye geçiş sınırı denetimi tetiklenir.
steps.expected: OBU, denetim hesabında min güvenli arka ucun konumunu (790 m) referans olarak kullanır.

steps.action: Denetim sonucundaki referans noktası kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Referans noktası 790 m olarak kaydedilmiştir.

test_cases.title: LRBG uyumlu balise grubunun konum referansı olarak kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim halindedir. Bağlantı tutarlılığı kontrolü yapılmaktadır. Sistemde en az bir LRBG uyumlu balise grubu (LRBGONB) geçilmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bağlantılı (linked) ve bağlantı bilgilerinde ilan edilmiş bir balise grubu (LRBG-1).
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG-1, SUBSET-026 §3.6.5.1.8'de belirtilen koşulları (mesaj içeriğinin işlenmesi) karşılamaktadır.

steps.action: Tren, LRBG-1 balise grubunu geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, LRBG-1'i LRBG uyumlu balise grubu olarak tanımlar.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC'ye gönderdiği konum raporları izlenir.
steps.expected: Konum raporları, LRBG-1'i referans nokta olarak kullanır.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı tutarlılığı kontrolü yapılmadığında LRBG uyumluluğunun belirlenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim halindedir. Bağlantı tutarlılığı kontrolü yapılmamaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bağlantısız (unlinked) olarak işaretlenmemiş bir balise grubu (LRBG-2).
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG-2, SUBSET-026 §3.6.5.1.8'de belirtilen koşulları karşılamaktadır.

steps.action: Tren, LRBG-2 balise grubunu geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, LRBG-2'yi LRBG uyumlu balise grubu olarak tanımlar.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC'ye gönderdiği konum raporları izlenir.
steps.expected: Konum raporları, LRBG-2'yi referans nokta olarak kullanır.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı tutarlılığı kontrolü yapıldığında uyumsuz balise grubunun reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim halindedir. Bağlantı tutarlılığı kontrolü yapılmaktadır. Önceki geçerli bir LRBGONB (LRBG-1) mevcuttur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bağlantılı (linked) olarak işaretlenmemiş veya bağlantı bilgilerinde ilan edilmemiş bir balise grubu (LRBG-3).
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG-3, SUBSET-026 §3.6.5.1.8'de belirtilen koşulları karşılamaktadır ancak bağlantı tutarlılığı kriterlerini karşılamamaktadır.

steps.action: Tren, LRBG-3 balise grubunu geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, LRBG-3'ü LRBG uyumlu balise grubu olarak tanımlamaz.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC'ye gönderdiği konum raporları izlenir.
steps.expected: Konum raporları, LRBG-3'ü referans nokta olarak kullanmaz; önceki geçerli LRBGONB (LRBG-1) referans olarak kalmaya devam eder.

test_cases.title: RBC'den gelen izleme bilgilerinin son raporlanan LRBG'lerden birine referans vermesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC'ye son 8 LRBGONB'yi raporlamıştır (LRBG-1, LRBG-2, ..., LRBG-8).
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen ve LRBG-5'e referans veren bir izleme mesajı.
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG-5, son raporlanan 8 LRBGONB'den biridir.

steps.action: RBC'den LRBG-5'e referans veren izleme mesajı OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, mesajı kabul eder ve işler.

test_cases.title: RBC'den gelen izleme bilgilerinin son raporlanan LRBG'lerin dışındaki bir LRBG'ye referans vermesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC'ye son 8 LRBGONB'yi raporlamıştır (LRBG-1, LRBG-2, ..., LRBG-8). LRBG-0, bu 8 grubun dışındadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen ve LRBG-0'a referans veren bir izleme mesajı.
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG-0, son raporlanan 8 LRBGONB'den biri değildir.

steps.action: RBC'den LRBG-0'a referans veren izleme mesajı OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, mesajı reddeder veya hata durumu oluşturur, çünkü referans verilen LRBG son raporlanan 8 LRBGONB arasında yer almamaktadır.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores information valid for the opposite train orientation
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it can receive data from a transmission medium (e.g., balise). The train orientation is set to 'Nominal'.
test_cases.test_inputs: A data packet with Q_DIR = 'Reverse' (00) is transmitted by a trackside device.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has a mechanism to log or indicate which data packets are processed and which are ignored.

steps.action: Transmit a data packet with Q_DIR = 'Reverse' (00) to the OBU while the train orientation is 'Nominal'.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the data packet. The internal state or profile data of the OBU remains unchanged.

steps.action: Transmit a data packet with Q_DIR = 'Nominal' (01) to the OBU while the train orientation is 'Nominal'.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the data packet. The internal state or profile data of the OBU is updated according to the packet content.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores information valid for the opposite train orientation (Reverse orientation)
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it can receive data from a transmission medium. The train orientation is set to 'Reverse'.
test_cases.test_inputs: A data packet with Q_DIR = 'Nominal' (01) is transmitted by a trackside device.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has a mechanism to log or indicate which data packets are processed and which are ignored.

steps.action: Transmit a data packet with Q_DIR = 'Nominal' (01) to the OBU while the train orientation is 'Reverse'.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the data packet. The internal state or profile data of the OBU remains unchanged.

steps.action: Transmit a data packet with Q_DIR = 'Reverse' (00) to the OBU while the train orientation is 'Reverse'.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the data packet. The internal state or profile data of the OBU is updated according to the packet content.

test_cases.title: OBU rejects one-direction data when train orientation cannot be related to trackside direction
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where the train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device (e.g., unknown crossing direction for SL/PS/SH engines or general ambiguity).
test_cases.test_inputs: A data packet with Q_DIR = 'Nominal' (01) is transmitted.
test_cases.assumptions: The condition 'train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device' is simulated or configured in the test environment.

steps.action: Transmit a data packet with Q_DIR = 'Nominal' (01) to the OBU under the condition that the train orientation cannot be related to the trackside direction.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the data packet. The internal state or profile data of the OBU remains unchanged.

test_cases.title: OBU evaluates data valid in both directions when train orientation cannot be related to trackside direction
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where the train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device.
test_cases.test_inputs: A data packet with Q_DIR = 'Both directions' (10) is transmitted.
test_cases.assumptions: The condition 'train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device' is simulated or configured in the test environment.

steps.action: Transmit a data packet with Q_DIR = 'Both directions' (10) to the OBU under the condition that the train orientation cannot be related to the trackside direction.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates and processes the data packet. The internal state or profile data of the OBU is updated according to the packet content.

test_cases.title: OBU interprets continuous profile data with incremental distances
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has previously received profile data. The current profile value is V_prev at distance D_prev.
test_cases.test_inputs: A continuous profile data packet containing: Value(1)=V1, Distance(2)=D2, Value(2)=V2, Distance(3)=D3, Value(3)=V3 (End of Profile).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the resulting speed profile for verification.

steps.action: Transmit the continuous profile data packet to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the profile. From the current position to D2, the speed limit is V_prev. From D2 to D2+D3, the speed limit is V1. From D2+D3 onwards, the speed limit is V2 until the end of profile marker is reached, where it becomes V3.

test_cases.title: OBU interprets continuous profile data with zero distance
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has previously received profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A continuous profile data packet containing: Value(1)=V1, Distance(2)=0, Value(2)=V2.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the resulting speed profile for verification.

steps.action: Transmit the continuous profile data packet with Distance(2)=0 to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU takes Value(1) into account. The profile reflects V1 immediately, and then V2 applies for the subsequent distance.

test_cases.title: OBU interprets location data with incremental distances
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has previously received location data. The current location reference is L_prev.
test_cases.test_inputs: A location data packet containing: Value(1)=L1, Distance(2)=D2, Value(2)=L2.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the resulting location data for verification.

steps.action: Transmit the location data packet to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the location data. The first segment uses the previously received data (L_prev). At distance D2, the location value changes to L1. At distance D2 + Distance(3) (if present), it would change to L2. In this case, L1 is valid from D2 onwards.

test_cases.title: OBU interprets non-continuous profile data with overlapping elements
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has previously received non-continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A non-continuous profile data packet containing: Element 1 (Value=V1, Length=L1, Distance=D1), Element 2 (Value=V2, Length=L2, Distance=D2) where D2 < L1 (overlap).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the resulting non-continuous profile elements for verification.

steps.action: Transmit the non-continuous profile data packet to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the elements. Element 1 starts at the previous end and has length L1. Element 2 starts at distance D2 from the start of Element 1. The OBU stores both elements, allowing for overlap as per the requirement.

test_cases.title: OBU interprets linking information for balise groups
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is ready to receive linking information.
test_cases.test_inputs: A linking information packet containing: Distance(1)=D1, Value(1)=LinkData1, Distance(2)=D2, Value(2)=LinkData2.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the resulting linking information for verification.

steps.action: Transmit the linking information packet to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets Distance(1) as the distance to the first announced balise group. It stores LinkData1 for that group. It interprets Distance(2) as the distance between the first and second announced balise groups. It stores LinkData2 for the second group.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive linking information. A balise group (BG1) is about to be read.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information containing Q_LOCACC for BG1 (e.g., 10m).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU internal state allows observation of the determined location accuracy for the current reference balise group.

steps.action: Read balise group BG1 which contains linking information specifying a location accuracy (Q_LOCACC) of 10m for itself.
steps.expected: The OBU determines the location accuracy of BG1 as 10m.

steps.action: Check the location accuracy value stored for BG1 in the OBU.
steps.expected: The stored location accuracy is 10m.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from National Value when linking is unavailable
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is configured with a National Value for location accuracy (e.g., 20m). No linking information is available for the upcoming balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group BG2 without linking information regarding its own location accuracy.
test_cases.assumptions: The National Value is applicable for the current location.

steps.action: Read balise group BG2 which does not contain linking information determining its location accuracy.
steps.expected: The OBU does not determine the location accuracy from linking.

steps.action: Wait until BG2 becomes the LRBG or ORBG.
steps.expected: The OBU determines the location accuracy of BG2 using the National Value (20m).

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from Default Value when no National Value applies
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a location where no National Value for location accuracy is applicable. No linking information is available for the upcoming balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group BG3 without linking information regarding its location accuracy.
test_cases.assumptions: The Default Value for location accuracy is 12m (as per SUBSET-026-3 §A.3.2).

steps.action: Read balise group BG3 which does not contain linking information determining its location accuracy.
steps.expected: The OBU does not determine the location accuracy from linking.

steps.action: Wait until BG3 becomes the LRBG or ORBG.
steps.expected: The OBU determines the location accuracy of BG3 using the Default Value (12m).

test_cases.title: Location accuracy is not updated by further linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has determined the location accuracy of the current reference balise group (BG1) as 10m from initial linking information.
test_cases.test_inputs: New linking information received later that implies a different location accuracy for BG1 (e.g., 15m).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows observation of the location accuracy value for the current reference balise group.

steps.action: Verify the current location accuracy of BG1 is 10m.
steps.expected: The location accuracy is 10m.

steps.action: Receive new linking information that would suggest a different location accuracy for BG1.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the new linking information.

steps.action: Check the location accuracy value stored for BG1.
steps.expected: The stored location accuracy remains 10m and is not updated to the new value.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy is not updated when linking is no longer checked
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has determined the location accuracy of the current reference balise group (BG1) as 10m. Linking consistency checking is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Conditions that cause linking consistency checking to stop (e.g., loss of valid linking data).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows observation of the location accuracy value and the status of linking consistency checking.

steps.action: Verify the current location accuracy of BG1 is 10m and linking consistency is being checked.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval calculation without consist length uncertainty
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where gamma (γ) is 0 (e.g., Full Supervision with valid Train Data). Location accuracy of reference BG is 10m. Overreading amount is 2m. Underreading amount is 3m.
test_cases.test_inputs: Estimated train front end position at 1000m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows observation of the min and max safe front end positions.

steps.action: Set the estimated train front end position to 1000m.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the confidence interval.

steps.action: Check the min safe front end position.
steps.expected: The min safe front end position is 1000m - (10m + 2m) = 988m.

steps.action: Check the max safe front end position.
steps.expected: The max safe front end position is 1000m + (10m + 3m) = 1013m.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval calculation with consist length uncertainty (Stand-By)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Stand-By mode with no valid Train Data but safe consist length information available. Gamma (γ) is 1. Location accuracy of reference BG is 10m. Overreading amount is 2m. Underreading amount is 3m. L_train_over is 5m. L_train_under is 4m.
test_cases.test_inputs: Estimated train front end position at 1000m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows observation of the min and max safe front end positions.

steps.action: Set the estimated train front end position to 1000m.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the confidence interval including consist length uncertainty.

steps.action: Check the min safe front end position.
steps.expected: The min safe front end position is 1000m - (10m + 2m + 1*5m) = 983m.

steps.action: Check the max safe front end position.
steps.expected: The max safe front end position is 1000m + (10m + 3m + 1*4m) = 1017m.

steps.expected: No MA request is sent due to the perturbation criterion.

test_cases.title: MA kısaltma isteğinin kabulü (Tren ISL arkasında)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA (M1) ve ilgili mod profili ile SH alanı balise grubu listesi (varsa) ile çalışmaktadır. RBC, mevcut EOA/LOA'dan daha yakın bir EOA içeren kısaltılmış MA (M2) isteği gönderir. Trenin ön ucu, M2'nin İndication supervision limit (ISL) değerinin arkasındadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen MA kısaltma isteği mesajı (M2, mod profili, SH balise listesi).
test_cases.assumptions: Tren konumu ve ISL değeri test ortamında kontrol edilebilir şekilde ayarlanmıştır.

steps.action: RBC, trenin ön ucunun önerilen ISL'nin arkasında olduğu durumda MA kısaltma isteğini gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU isteği kabul eder ve önerilen kısaltılmış MA'yı (M2), mod profilini ve SH alanı balise grubu listesini (varsa) yeni MA olarak kabul eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC'ye gönderdiği yanıt mesajı gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC'ye isteğin kabul edildiğini bildiren bir mesaj gönderir.

test_cases.title: MA kısaltma isteğinin reddi (Tren ISL önünde)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA (M1) ve ilgili mod profili ile SH alanı balise grubu listesi (varsa) ile çalışmaktadır. RBC, mevcut EOA/LOA'dan daha yakın bir EOA içeren kısaltılmış MA (M2) isteği gönderir. Trenin ön ucu, M2'nin İndication supervision limit (ISL) değerinin önündedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen MA kısaltma isteği mesajı (M2, mod profili, SH balise listesi).
test_cases.assumptions: Tren konumu ve ISL değeri test ortamında kontrol edilebilir şekilde ayarlanmıştır.

steps.action: RBC, trenin ön ucunun önerilen ISL'nin önünde olduğu durumda MA kısaltma isteğini gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU isteği reddeder. Önceki MA (M1), mod profili ve SH alanı balise grubu listesi (varsa) geçerli kalmaya devam eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC'ye gönderdiği yanıt mesajı gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC'ye isteğin reddedildiğini bildiren bir mesaj gönderir.

test_cases.title: MA kısaltma isteğinin sınırı (Tren ISL üzerinde)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA (M1) ile çalışmaktadır. RBC, kısaltılmış MA (M2) isteği gönderir. Trenin ön ucu, M2'nin İndication supervision limit (ISL) değeriyle tam olarak aynı konumdadır (ne arkasında ne de önünde).
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen MA kısaltma isteği mesajı (M2).
test_cases.assumptions: Tren konumu, ISL değeriyle birebir eşleşecek şekilde hassas ayarlanmıştır. 'In rear' ifadesi, konumun ISL'den küçük veya eşit olduğu anlamına gelmez; genellikle 'in rear' < ISL, 'in advance' > ISL olarak yorumlanır. Ancak gereksinim 'in rear' ve 'in advance' diyor. Eşitlik durumu belirsizdir. Genellikle sınır değerlerde güvenlik için reddedilir veya kabul edilir. ERTMS'te genellikle 'in rear' <= ISL kabul edilir. Ancak metin 'in rear' ve 'in advance' diyor. Eşitlik durumu için 'in rear' olarak kabul edilebilir. Test senaryosu olarak eşitlik durumunu test etmek için 'in rear' kabulü beklenir.

steps.action: RBC, trenin ön ucunun önerilen ISL ile aynı konumda olduğu durumda MA kısaltma isteğini gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU isteği kabul eder (tren ISL'nin arkasında veya üzerinde kabul edilir) ve yeni MA'yı uygular.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC'ye gönderdiği yanıt mesajı gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC'ye isteğin kabul edildiğini bildiren bir mesaj gönderir.

test_cases.title: Revocation message acknowledgement with valid timestamp
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive and process messages from the trackside. The trackside is configured to send a revocation message for an emergency message with a request for acknowledgement.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid revocation message for an emergency message, including a request for acknowledgement and a specific timestamp (e.g., T1).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is correctly configured to follow the general acknowledgement procedure defined in SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.5.

steps.action: Send a revocation message for an emergency message from the trackside to the OBU, including a request for acknowledgement and timestamp T1.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the message and identifies it as a revocation message requiring acknowledgement.

steps.action: Wait for the OBU to process the message and send the acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message to the trackside.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the acknowledgement message sent by the OBU.
steps.expected: The acknowledgement message refers to the timestamp T1 of the revocation message sent by the trackside.

test_cases.title: Revocation message acknowledgement with inconsistent message
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive and process messages from the trackside. The trackside is configured to send a revocation message that is considered inconsistent (e.g., invalid format or conflicting data).
test_cases.test_inputs: An inconsistent revocation message for an emergency message, including a request for acknowledgement.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has logic to detect inconsistent messages as per the general acknowledgement procedure.

steps.action: Send an inconsistent revocation message for an emergency message from the trackside to the OBU, including a request for acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the message and identifies it as inconsistent.

steps.action: Wait for the OBU to process the message.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send an acknowledgement message to the trackside.

test_cases.title: Display appearance for important information without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where text messages are displayed. The display area is clear of other messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with class 'Important Information' and 'Driver Acknowledgement Requested' = 'No'.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU display supports distinguishing between bold and regular text styles.

steps.action: Send a text message from trackside with class 'Important Information' and no acknowledgement request.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the message in the first group area (above auxiliary messages) with bold characters.

steps.expected: The OBU displays the message alone in the designated acknowledgement area (E5-E9 or E5-E8), hiding other non-acknowledgement messages, with bold characters.

test_cases.title: Start condition with multiple sub-conditions defined as 'Any'
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where text messages are displayed.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with start sub-conditions: Location A and Mode B. Trackside defines the condition logic as 'Any' (OR).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can receive and process the 'Any' vs 'All' logic flag from trackside.

steps.action: Set the train position to Location A, but keep the OBU in a mode different from Mode B.
steps.expected: The start condition is considered fulfilled because one of the sub-conditions (Location) is met.

steps.action: Verify the message display status.
steps.expected: The text message is displayed (assuming end condition is not immediately fulfilled).

test_cases.title: Start condition with multiple sub-conditions defined as 'All'
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where text messages are displayed.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with start sub-conditions: Location A and Mode B. Trackside defines the condition logic as 'All' (AND).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can receive and process the 'Any' vs 'All' logic flag from trackside.

steps.action: Set the train position to Location A, but keep the OBU in a mode different from Mode B.
steps.expected: The start condition is NOT considered fulfilled because not all sub-conditions are met.

steps.action: Verify the message display status.
steps.expected: The text message is NOT displayed.

steps.action: Change the OBU to Mode B while remaining at Location A.
steps.expected: The start condition is now considered fulfilled because all sub-conditions are met.

steps.action: Verify the message display status.
steps.expected: The text message is displayed.

test_cases.title: End condition with multiple sub-conditions defined as 'Any'
test_cases.preconditions: A text message is currently displayed. The start condition was fulfilled.
test_cases.test_inputs: The active text message has end sub-conditions: Location C and Time 10s. Trackside defines the end condition logic as 'Any' (OR).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can receive and process the 'Any' vs 'All' logic flag from trackside.

steps.action: Wait for 5 seconds without reaching Location C.
steps.expected: The message remains displayed because neither end sub-condition is met.

steps.action: Wait for another 5 seconds (total 10s) without reaching Location C.
steps.expected: The end condition is considered fulfilled because the time sub-condition is met.

steps.action: Verify the message display status.
steps.expected: The text message is no longer displayed.

test_cases.title: End condition with multiple sub-conditions defined as 'All'
test_cases.preconditions: A text message is currently displayed. The start condition was fulfilled.
test_cases.test_inputs: The active text message has end sub-conditions: Location C and Time 10s. Trackside defines the end condition logic as 'All' (AND).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can receive and process the 'Any' vs 'All' logic flag from trackside.

steps.action: Wait for 10 seconds without reaching Location C.
steps.expected: The message remains displayed because the location sub-condition is not met, even though time is.

steps.action: Move the train to Location C.
steps.expected: The end condition is considered fulfilled because both sub-conditions are now met.

steps.action: Verify the message display status.
steps.expected: The text message is no longer displayed.

test_cases.title: Start condition with no sub-conditions defined
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where text messages are displayed.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with no start sub-conditions defined (empty list).

steps.action: Send the text message from trackside.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the start condition as immediately fulfilled.

steps.action: Verify the message display status.
steps.expected: The text message is displayed immediately (assuming end condition is not immediately fulfilled).

test_cases.title: Acknowledgement ends display regardless of end condition
test_cases.preconditions: A text message requesting driver acknowledgement is displayed. The message is defined such that acknowledgement ends the display.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with 'Driver Acknowledgement Requested' = 'Yes' and 'Ack Ends Display' = 'Yes'. The end condition is defined as Location D, which has not been reached.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the acknowledgement as ending the text display.

steps.action: Verify the message display status.
steps.expected: The text message is no longer displayed, even though the location end condition has not been met.

test_cases.title: Acknowledgement is a necessary condition for ending display
test_cases.preconditions: A text message requesting driver acknowledgement is displayed. The message is defined such that acknowledgement is a necessary condition for ending the display, in addition to the end condition.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with 'Driver Acknowledgement Requested' = 'Yes' and 'Ack Ends Display' = 'No' (Ack is necessary but not sufficient). The end condition is defined as Location D.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message.
steps.expected: The OBU records the acknowledgement but does not end the display yet.

steps.action: Verify the message display status.
steps.expected: The text message is still displayed.

steps.action: Move the train to Location D.
steps.expected: The end condition is fulfilled.

steps.action: Verify the message display status.
steps.expected: The text message is no longer displayed, as both the end condition and the acknowledgement are met.

test_cases.title: No display if end condition is immediately fulfilled
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where text messages are displayed.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with start condition: Location A. End condition: Location B, where Location B is immediately after Location A (or the train is already past Location B when it reaches Location A).
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving such that it passes Location A and Location B in quick succession, or the end condition is already true at the moment the start condition becomes true.

steps.action: Move the train to Location A.
steps.expected: The start condition is fulfilled.

steps.action: Verify the message display status.
steps.expected: The text message is NOT displayed because the end condition is already fulfilled at the moment the start condition is fulfilled.

test_cases.title: No display if end condition is immediately fulfilled with acknowledgement request
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where text messages are displayed.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message requesting driver acknowledgement. Start condition: Location A. End condition: Location B, where Location B is immediately after Location A.

steps.action: Move the train to Location A.
steps.expected: The start condition is fulfilled.

steps.action: Verify the message display status.
steps.expected: The text message is NOT displayed, even though driver confirmation is requested, because the end condition is already fulfilled.

test_cases.title: Display length measured from start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where text messages are displayed.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with start sub-conditions: Location A and Mode B. End sub-condition: Location C. The distance between Location A and Location C is 1000m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can track the train's position relative to the start location.

steps.action: Set the train position to Location A and OBU to Mode B.
steps.expected: The start condition is fulfilled.

steps.action: Verify the message display status.
steps.expected: The text message is displayed.

steps.action: Move the train 500m from Location A (towards Location C).
steps.expected: The text message is still displayed.

steps.action: Move the train another 500m (total 1000m from Location A, reaching Location C).
steps.expected: The end condition is fulfilled.

steps.action: Verify the message display status.
steps.expected: The text message is no longer displayed.

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement report sent to RBC
test_cases.preconditions: A text message requesting a report of driver acknowledgement is displayed. The message includes a reference to a specific RBC.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a driver acknowledgement report to the referenced RBC.

steps.action: Verify the content of the sent report.

test_cases.title: Reject new text message with same identifier as unacknowledged message
test_cases.preconditions: A text message with identifier 'TM-456' requesting a report of driver acknowledgement is currently displayed and has not been acknowledged by the driver.

steps.action: Send the new text message with identifier 'TM-456' from trackside.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the new text message.

steps.action: Verify the display status.
steps.expected: The original text message with identifier 'TM-456' remains displayed, and the new message is not shown.

test_cases.title: Accept new text message with same identifier as acknowledged message
test_cases.preconditions: A text message with identifier 'TM-789' requesting a report of driver acknowledgement was previously displayed and has been acknowledged by the driver.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new text message with identifier 'TM-789' requesting a report of driver acknowledgement.

steps.action: Send the new text message with identifier 'TM-789' from trackside.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new text message.

steps.action: Verify the display status.
steps.expected: The new text message with identifier 'TM-789' is displayed.

test_cases.title: OS/LS Mode Profile deletion beyond infill reference

test_cases.test_inputs: New MA by infill with reference location in advance of the start of the active SH Mode Profile, containing a new Mode Profile and SH balise group list.
